HOW TO USE AND PARTICIPATE

To start, check out all the costumes in this sprite. Those are all the ingredients except for the one called "FINAL RESULT".


REMIX THE PROJECT and get inside this sprite once again.

Now you want to make your stuff. 
Press AND hold "W" until a list appears. It should be empty.

Time to "cook"! 

-Use the A and D keys to scroll through the ingredients.

-Press space to add an ingredient to the list. You can do this as many times as you want, but DON'T spam it hard.

-Use X to delete the last ingredient in the list, or hold W to reset your food.

(RECOMMENDED: view all ingredients carefully!)

Use the costume called "indicator" to indicate what you cook next will be the tae

Finished? SAVE YOUR REMIX!
Go to the "FINAL RESULT" costume. 
Draw your Sushi and Tea!

Now, you can press "0" to see all your ingredients being baked to make sure you're satisfied with your creation. If you ARE, share the project! Make sure to double-check your enchilada's ingredients were not deleted.
